'''Shikobuchi Jinja''' (思子淵神社) refers to multiple {{ill|Shinto shrine|en|Shinto shrine|qid=Q845945|lt=Shrines}} located in the {{ill|Ado River|ja|安曇川|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Azumi River|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11450763}} basin, including {{ill|Shiga Prefecture|en|Shiga Prefecture|qid=Q131358|lt=Shiga Prefecture}}'s {{ill|Takashima, Shiga|en|Takashima, Shiga|qid=Q845794|lt=Takashima City}} and {{ill|Kyoto|en|Kyoto|qid=Q34600|lt=Kyoto City}}.

* {{ill|Shikobuchi Shrine (Takashima City)|ja|思子淵神社 (高島市安曇川町中野)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikobuchi Shrine (Takashima City)|qq=}} - Located in Azumi-gawa Town.
* {{ill|Shikobuchi Jinja (Takashima City, Kutsuki Ogawa)|ja|思子淵神社 (高島市朽木小川)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikobuchi Jinja (Takashima City, Kutsuki Ogawa)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} - Located in Kutsuki Ogawa.
* {{ill|Shikobuchi Jinja (Takashima City, Kutsuki Taira)|ja|思子淵神社 (高島市朽木平良)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikobuchi Jinja (Takashima City, Kutsuki Taira)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} - Located in Kutsuki Taira.
* {{ill|Shikobuchi Shrine (Kyoto City, Sakyo-ku, Kuta)|ja|思古渕社|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikobuchi Shrine (Kyoto City, Sakyo-ku, Kuta)|qq=}} - Located in Kuta, Sakyo-ku, Kyoto.
